added.summary: New guide effects, the entry for effects: which tool to use for what (an effect pack, a pixel effect, a composed effect, one emitter, a trail, a beam, a decal, a screen effect, a hit stop and a shake, and which of the several sprite-sheet, dissolve and distortion paths), a composed effect written from nothing with its emitter and effect material and previewed with og vfx preview, how to choose elements, and the budget an effect is held to (a one-shot effect's peak 0.5 ms, a looping one 0.2 ms, everything on screen 1.5 to 2 ms on the reference host).
